lines: #When you start changing, not everyone will *come* with you.
You'll say no to the nights out. The *gossip.* The excuses.
You'll wonder if you're doing something *wrong.*
You're just walking a path most people don't *choose.*
And fewer people walk with you *there.*
The road gets quieter the higher you *climb.*
That's not a warning. It's a *sign* you're climbing.
Your thoughts. Your *training.* Your quiet mornings.
#Because the people who can sit alone with their goals are *dangerous.*
They don't need anyone's permission. Or anyone's *applause.*
The further you go, the more you'll meet people walking the *same* way.
end: Follow for your daily push at 7am & 7pm.

post.title: If Your Journey Feels Lonely, Watch This
post.caption: Not everyone will come with you. Keep walking. 🛤️
post.first_comment: Who else is walking this road alone right now? 👇
